x_note: ADR-0011 section 4 / 6 (N-1). An example of the effective node-local policy relevant to one executed workload, over which local_policy_digest = SHA-256(RFC 8785 JCS(...)) is computed. Local policy may only NARROW or DENY authorized behaviour; it never substitutes execution semantics. Secret VALUES never appear here; only secret_ref -> local value source name. DServer stores local_policy_digest for audit but is not authoritative over local policy.
